slides.headline: Meta's new AI watches more than it helps
Meta launched Muse this week
slides.body: A personal AI agent meant to run errands on your phone

slides.headline: It records every screen and click
slides.body: Muse sees your messages, purchases, and location to learn habits

slides.headline: Reviewers say it barely completes tasks
slides.body: It forgets instructions, books wrong dates, and misunderstands simple requests

slides.headline: Your data trains Meta's ad machine
slides.body: Everything you share with Muse feeds targeted advertising profiles

slides.headline: Don't trade privacy for broken help
slides.body: Follow for AI warnings that protect your data
